title: Services agreement with repeated survival boilerplate
notes: "This obligation survives termination or expiry of this Agreement." appears three times. Quoting it alone is ambiguous and cannot be verified; evidence must quote the distinguishing clause text.

clauses.span: Thereafter this Agreement renews automatically for successive three (3) month periods

During the term of this Agreement and for twenty-four (24) months afterwards, Client shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or hire any employee or contractor of Provider who worked on Client's account.
If Client breaches this Section, Client shall pay Provider a placement fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of that person's annual compensation.
Overdue amounts accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving 45 days' written notice.

governing_law.span: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Vermont.
